    /**

     *
     * @dataProvider providerSheetNumber
     */
    public function testIssue4112(?int $sheetNumber): void

    }

part.text: All remaining failures are pre-existing (environment-related: GD/fonts/samples) and identical to the baseline — the 3 `Issue4112Test` errors are gone. Quick style check:

Fixed. The bug was in `Worksheet::addToSpreadsheet` (src/PhpSpreadsheet/Worksheet/Worksheet.php:871): after removing all sheets, `activeSheetIndex` becomes `-1`, and adding a sheet with an explicit index didn't correct it — leaving the workbook with an invalid active sheet index and causing the "sheet index -1 is out of bounds" exception on the next `getCell` call.

The fix:
- When the active index is negative, the newly inserted sheet's actual position (computed the same way `array_splice` clamps out-of-bounds offsets) becomes the active sheet index; for the append case it becomes the last position.
- The existing behavior when a valid active index exists is unchanged.

Verified with `Issue4112Test` (all 5 data sets pass), `SpreadsheetTest`, `WorksheetTest`, and the full suite showing no new failures.
